steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Dorothy... Dorothy! Are you okay?!

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Yes, I'm fine.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: S-Slow down. You almost knocked me over...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It's all my fault. If I'd found out what Ferdinand's been up to sooner... If I'd figured out a way to tell everyone sooner... If I'd talked to you a little more... If...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Sheesh, look at you... You came all the way here from observation in a hurry. There's dirt on your face.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It might've gotten on my face when I was beating up Ferdinand.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I already forgot what I grabbed to beat him with... My hand was shaking really bad.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Were you taking it out on him?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: No... That didn't feel good at all.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Dorothy, I'm disappointed, and I'm angry, but after the dust settled, and after seeing those soldiers run after him... I also started to feel really bad.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Because of everything Ferdinand did?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: No, because... because of what he could've done.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I still remember everything he taught me, and I still believe that, when he told me about his grand ideas, there wasn't an inkling of deception behind the light in his eyes.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: And... there was a time... when I wanted his recognition more than anything...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: That's gotta be really silly, right? Saying stuff like that?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Not even a little, Elena.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Sometimes... It's harder to accept than to deny.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: You won't have to be anyone's assistant ever again.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: He won't cast his shadow on you again, but the flames he lit still burn in your eyes. His end is your start point, and there's no doubt you will walk much farther than he ever did.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Dorothy...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Why do you sound like you're saying goodbye? What do you mean I won't be an assistant anymore...? I know you plugged yourself into the 'Hub,' but that doesn't mean there's something wrong with your body, right?!

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Calm down...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I'm fine. If you don't believe me, ask our good doctor...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I make no guarantees.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Olivia, are you finished checking all the Pioneers?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: There's still one more to go.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The 'Transmitter' is still flowing through you.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You are showing no physical abnormalities at the moment, but no one can tell how things might develop in the future.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: You don't need to worry about me, my dear doctor.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: These substances flowing inside me pose no greater threat than the crystals on your bodies... and the brewing storm up ahead.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: But those little things won't stop us, will they?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Certainly not.
The out-of-control construct caused significant destruction to the base.
There is hardly any rubble in front of them; only a clean floor of silvery white.
Before long, even that will be cleaned up.
But... there will always be traces left here.
Suddenly, the silver river in front of them begins to move again.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The reflection of the rainclouds, huh...?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Acknowledged.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: The government has taken over all administration of the site, and per our agreement, Rhodes Island needs to destroy all the information we've collected.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: But this isn't the end.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I just got a new lead about Ferdinand's backer. I'm on my way to meet with the informant now.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Doctor...
Saria stops in her tracks and looks up.
There are rainclouds slowly drifting their way into the city.
At the test site some sixty miles away...
Somebody else is thinking the exact same thing.

steps.name: Silence & Saria
steps.text: It's about to rain in Trimounts.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: That's pretty much a wrap.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Thanks for helping us clean up, Greyy.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: I'm glad I could help, Mr. Sonny.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: And uh... there's not actually much to clean.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: We did good. Looks just like how things were when we got here.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Hey, do me a favor and pass on our apology and some thanks to your coworkers. It's just like you said. You Rhodes Islanders pulled us up out of our funk.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: No, Mr. Sonny. It was you and the rest of the Pioneers who saved yourselves.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Did you forget? If you hadn't made your 'voice' heard, we wouldn't have had the chance to take your hand.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I'm blessed to have a friend like you.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: My little engineer buddy, I'll never forget what you told me, not to mention everything that happened here at the site.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: And Mary...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: It's my job to make sure all of you get away from the site.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: What I was gonna say is... you still got a chance to arrest me.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: This whole mess is an experiment gone wrong, thanks to the work of a lone actor—That's the word from on high anyway.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: And since those Rhine researchers don't want to press charges, your little 'kidnapping' isn't in the records.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: No, I'm not talking about the last couple days.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I'm talking about... four years ago.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Do you know why I signed up for the experiment that night?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Every Pioneer has a reason to wanna go back to the city, and my reason is...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I have to go back to someone I hurt bad—Someone who used to be my dearest friend.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I owe her an apology, and—

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I deserve to be judged.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I've been on the run for four years. At first, I thought the wastes swallowed my dreams, and changed me into a different man...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: But that's not what happened.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: On that night four years ago, I killed the Sonny Romano who believed in justice and equality. I did it with my own two hands.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: If you do get arrested, there's only two possible punishments waiting for you.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: One, you'll get thrown in prison and then the Infected quarantine zone once you've done your time.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: And the other...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: You be a Pioneer, and the nomadic cities will be closed to you forever.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: But you're already a Pioneer.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: So that means you...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Let's stop it with all this talk about whether I forgive you or not. Your old buddy is here to send you on your way. Shouldn't you hurry up and do something more meaningful?
A long overdue, warm hug.
A true reunion, and also a formal farewell after years apart.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Have you figured out where to go next?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: It's some guy who's got a bunch of letters for a name. Starts with a D. He sent us all a kinda weird email the other day, and there was an invitation to work with him attached.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I still have no idea how he got the contact information for the Pioneer Team... He doesn't seem like he's from a recruiting agency.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: You should be more careful the next time you pick up work...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Try not to break the law again either. Otherwise, it doesn't matter where you run. I'll drag you back here. I promise.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Haha...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You got it, Officer.
Not far away, his brothers and sisters on the Pioneer Team call out to him.
Sonny knows that, this time, he's truly prepared to go on his journey.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: They started cleaning up the mess at the test site.

options: It was your Energy Director who made the mess anyway...
Rhine Lab's still in charge of cleanup.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Yeah... I guess this is a kinda corporate social responsibility for us, huh?

options: I'm more willing to believe this is a deal.
On the essence of what you just said, I agree.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Alright, not like there's anyone who believes that explanation here.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Those Pioneers...

options: You've been watching them for a while.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: They're starting a new journey.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I wonder... what they'll find next time?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Again and again in a never-ending cycle.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: They can never go back home, and they might never again have a place they can even call home.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Doctor, I found that the Rhine personnel are digging away in the rubble of the labs...

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Director Muelsyse, you're here too.

options: Have you figured out when you'll answer my question yet?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Question... What is it that's bothering me?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: When I'm prepared to talk...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You'll be the first to know, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Relax... It's all been taken care of. No civilians will ever find out what happened at Site 359, and there is no chance of anyone using this against you in your upcoming election.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Yes, I'm well out of Trimounts already, on my way to Max D.C. now.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Ferdinand...?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: He's no threat anymore. You can be sure of that.

steps.name: Columbian Mercenary
steps.text: Ma'am... Y-You're standing right outside Rhine Lab. Why did you lie to the vice president?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Because...

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I still remember my original goal.
He doesn't know how far he's walked.
His aching, hoarse throat reminds him that his body cannot bear such exhaustion.
However... It feels as though Trimounts is right behind him.
It could be right in front of him too.
The shadow of a nomadic city is enormous, and it grows endlessly with the passage of time.
He must hurry... hurry...
Where is he going in such a hurry? Will someone betray him at the next waypoint, just as Elena and Ho'olheyak did?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Hold it there.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: We know who you are.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Ferdinand... You think you get to just walk away scot-free after everything you've done?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Don't think that gear you're in is going to scare us. You talk big, but you can't actually control it.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Even if you open fire and kill us all here...

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: You'll run into the next team of Pioneers.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Look out into the wastes! No friends here! Your enemies go on forever!
It doesn't matter.

The 'Transmitter' he developed himself is right at his fingertips. All he has to do is inject it into himself, and he will immediately be able to wield this power armor with ease, and all these so-called enemies will be powerless against him.
But why doesn't he do it?
Is it because he doesn't have the courage that Dorothy does?
Or is it because...
Ferdinand, you are the one who's being left behind by the times—the grand ideals in your eyes.
Because you never believed that you belong to this epoch.
You always talk about how you're in control of it, you're always thinking, controlling... but you never feel.
Whose voice is this? Is it... Elena's?
Right, if you don't want to be left behind... you must become a part of it.
The power armor remains silent. It proceeds no further, and it does not put up a struggle.
It simply raises its arms...
Just like it is embracing the winds, the sunlight, and the lands before it.
An onslaught of angry Pioneers rushes toward it, and just as the silver monster that once hovered midair above the test site—swallows the iron-forged body whole.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: Does the Maylander Foundation still have doubts about this?
No, Control.
I'm not representing Maylander this time.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: I'm a busy woman, you know...
Right. It so happens I prefer to skip the pleasantries.
You retrieved the most crucial part of the experiment at Site 359.
The 'Hub' was destroyed in its entirety, by Dorothy—That's what it says in the report submitted to the government.
But it so happens that I saw a team in some pretty low-key outfits driving a discreet, completely curtained off transport into your personal laboratory.
Saria said you turned a blind eye to what Ferdinand was doing... Perhaps it would be more accurate to say you used him.
The thing that you wanted most is now sitting right on your desk.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: The cleanup work at Site 359 is a project that Rhine Lab had to take.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: And every day, countless failed experiments' byproducts are destroyed.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: No matter what it is you think you saw, it's not worthy of outside attention.
Destroyed? Well, of course. I'm sure that scrap heap is gone from your desk.
Evidence can be destroyed, and memories can be modified, but whenever something happens, it tends to have a lasting effect on the things that come after.
Loken, Parvis, Ferdinand... Maybe, at some point in the future, their names will be completely absent from the history books.
But there is no doubt they changed the course of history.
Arts Unit implants, technologies imbued with revived ancient Sarkaz powers, power armor controllable over a long distance, and mental manifestation networks over even broader areas...
What will be the next experiment that alters the very epoch we live in?

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: A researcher is here to explore all the possibilities out there.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: I don't make predictions.
Suppose that memories can leap past the limitations of time. Predictions are nothing more than rediscovering history that's been buried.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Why don't we reacquaint ourselves, Kristen Wright?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I'm Ho'olheyak, historian and Honorary President of the Columbian Astrological Research Association.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: And forgive me for making a prediction right here and now—

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Perhaps... I will be the partner you will most need, and very soon.

steps.name: Rhine Researcher
steps.text: Miss Astesia, Researcher Elena isn't back yet.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I know... She's told me already.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I just want to stay here a little while. So I can see her when she comes back.

steps.name: Rhine Researcher
steps.text: Haha... Sometimes, I'm jealous of Elena, having a sister that cares so much about her.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Who was that...?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: The astrolabe... lit up?
The sky after rain is always exceptionally clear.
This is one of the rare reasons that Kristen ever steps out of her laboratory.
It isn't that she particularly likes the twinkling lights. If conjectures cannot be proven, then they are only self-deceiving lies.
Yet lies aren't completely meaningless. Even if a shadow has been twisted thousands of times, it is still cast by something that is real and truthful.
Lies exist only to demonstrate one thing—that the truth also exists.
It is hidden among these radiant, twinkling stars, and the sky also isn't as far as it seems.
When she reaches her hand out, she will surely be able to touch it—
The only truth that has been suffocating the people from up above for thousands of years.
